title: `carryVoteForward()` enables double voting
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `Voter.carryVoteForward()` function allows voters to reuse their previous period's votes (pools and weights) for the upcoming period.
